info.title: Ray'z Staff app API
info.description: For the Ray'z Staff app (replacing Squire Commander). Separate from the customer API at /api/v1. Sign in with email and password (and the authenticator code where set up), then send Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>. Access tokens last an hour; refresh with the rotating refresh token. Roles, permissions, Client data masking and each location's sign-in rule are enforced on the server on every request; where a location takes approved devices, send X-Device-Token (POST /auth/device/request) on sign-in and every request. Data on the phone (ST-I18): keep a response, encrypted for at most 24 hours, only when its X-Staff-Cache header is offline-24h; with no signal the app is read-only except clock punches, queued with queuedAt and clientPunchId. Kiosk and QR punches always go in at the server's UTC time, never the device's. GET /config dataProtection has the rest: app lock, snapshot blur, no copy or share, and wipes. Quiet hours (ST-I20): off the clock, non-urgent pushes are held until clock-in, the break's end or the next shift; GET /config quietHours lists which events always go at once.

post.summary: Clock in or out from their phone with the front-desk clock's QR code as proof.qr. { kind: confirm } asks first during time off (send again with a new nonce); clocking in returns welcome (milestones). A phone punches only with the code a paired front-desk clock shows (GET /kiosk/qr or /clock/kiosk/qr): signed, good for a minute, and used up by one scan (409 details.reason qr_used; scan the next one). Location, Wi-Fi, the NFC sticker or nothing are 403 details.reason kiosk_required. Without the server's CLOCK_HMAC_SECRET every clock route is 500 details.reason clock_secret_missing.

get.summary: My Earnings for one pay period (period=current or a period id), or for from and to (America/Chicago dates, up to 92 days). from/to that are exactly one pay period are that period; any other from/to has period null, periods [], previousPeriodId and nextPeriodId null, and range { kind (weeks for whole Sunday–Saturday workweeks, review otherwise), wholeWorkweeks, partialWeeks (workweeks only partly in the dates: their OT is worked out over the whole week, so the OT on those days is an estimate), excluded (shops whose payroll comes from Squire's per-period report) }, at every shop of theirs; isEstimate stays true unless every shop is locked at exactly those dates. Sales, refunds, tips, commission (at the Payroll setup rate in effect on each sale date), training and hours all cover the same dates. Every amount is integer cents, computed on the server by the same code that builds the Payroll Report and the iSolved file, so the app does no pay math: hours (timesheet.own), hourlyPayCents, serviceCommissionCents, greaterOfCents with appliedRule (hourly, commission, or mixed across shops) and explanationCode, product and late commission, commSalesCents (E_Comm Sales), OT and PTO pay (compensation.own); training, its own line outside the greater-of (training: hours, rateCents, null when it changed in the period or differs by shop, payCents, inGreaterOf false, paidAsOvertimeHours, overtimeShareHours and overtimeShareCents (training's share of their OT hours and of the estimated OT pay; training hours count toward each week's 40 across every shop), countsTowardOt and otNote; also per shop; trainingPayCents is in wagesCents), card and cash tips (tips.own; cash includes declared cash, so totalTipsCents is E_Cash Tips Recd), sales (report.my_sales.view with reports.money) and totalCents (wages plus E_Cash Tips Recd; null unless they may see both wages and tips); pph, their own Productivity Per Hour (workedHours, servicePphCents, productPphCents, totalPphCents: service and product sales before tax and tips over worked hours, regular plus OT, training and PTO left out; clients, their completed service tickets, and clientsPerHour, those over the same hours to 2 decimals; each rate null and na true with no worked hours; also per shop; null unless they may see both sales and hours). productPerClient, their own product sales per client (productSalesCents, Product$ before tax; uniqueClients, the distinct clients of their completed tickets, a client once however often they came and a walk-in once per ticket; productSalesPerClientCents, those sales over those clients to the cent, null and na true with no clients; also per shop; null unless they may see their sales). Parts they may not see are null. Pay comes from periodPay, the payroll engine function the Payroll Report and the iSolved file use. A locked or exported period is what its lock kept (fromLock true), never worked out again. periodStatus (draft, approved, locked or exported), exportStatus, isEstimate (true until locked), snapshotId and computedAt say how final it is. OT: otPremiumCents is an estimate (otIsEstimate true, otDisclosure to show) since iSolved applies the final 1.5x; workweeks[] has each Chicago workweek (Sunday to Saturday) with hours at every shop added up, each shop's part (shops[]), basisHours and otHours. adjustments[]: changes after a period was exported, paid in this open period and flagged: late_tip, late_declaration (cash tips declared after their period locked) and tip_refunded_after_export (effectCents 0: the shop covers it). A locked period is never reopened, pay is never negative and a tip is never clawed back. shops[] has the same per shop with reconciliation against their iSolved row, fromLock, and tipToBarber and tipTransfersEnabled (the shop's tip switch). Every amount is gross: there are no withholding, tax or net pay fields, and taxNote (show it with the totals) says taxes are withheld through payroll. post.summary: Punch as the person whose tile was tapped, with their PIN (direction in or out; in when left out); returns punch too. A wrong PIN is 400; five in a row lock theirs (409 details.reason pin_locked) until a manager's POST /kiosk/pin/unlock, and setting a new PIN doesn't lift it. Ten wrong PINs on one kiosk in 15 minutes, or 30 tries for one person, are 429. Every try is audit-logged. Cash tips are declared on their phone, not here. A phone punches only with the code a paired front-desk clock shows (GET /kiosk/qr or /clock/kiosk/qr): signed, good for a minute, and used up by one scan (409 details.reason qr_used; scan the next one). Location, Wi-Fi, the NFC sticker or nothing are 403 details.reason kiosk_required. Without the server's CLOCK_HMAC_SECRET every clock route is 500 details.reason clock_secret_missing.
